description: Start a conversation with a candidate by talent slug, optionally with a first message. If the conversation already exists, returns it. Use search_talent to find candidates first, then use their slug here. A first message takes two calls: without confirm_token nothing is created or sent, and the reply is a preview of the exact text with a confirm_token; calling again with the same message and that token sends it. The candidate reads it as coming from the user's company and it can't be unsent, so show the user the preview and get their OK before the second call. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

confirm_token.description: Leave out to get a preview; nothing is sent. Pass the token from that preview, with the same message, to send it

message.description: Optional initial message to send with the conversation

talent_slug.description: Talent slug of the candidate to message (from search_talent results)

name: start_conversation
title: Start conversation with candidate
